observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor hall or studio with wooden floor, seated audience forming a semi-circle behind the performance area
observation.dancers: one couple, a woman and a man
observation.formation_and_space: couple performing facing each other, moving around the performance space while traveling and separating
observation.posture: upright torso, soft knees, weight shifted on stepping
observation.footwork: steady walking steps, side-to-side weight changes, and accented foot taps or small hops on beats
observation.arms_and_hands: hands held together in starting pose, arms relaxed at sides or lifted gracefully during turns and separation
observation.hips_and_torso: torso upright and stable, no hip isolations
observation.partnering: coupled start and finish with hand connection, separated during solo travel sections
observation.levels_jumps_turns: upright level, small jumps/hops on feet, graceful turns
observation.costume_and_props: historical-style Renaissance costume: woman in dark patterned gown with ruff/collars, man in patterned doublet with breeches and dark hose
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement details and subtle weight transfers due to camera angle and distance

signature_moments.what: couple standing hand in hand facing each other in starting pose
male dancer walking solo around the performance space with steps timed to the music
solo stepping sequence with small foot taps on beats
solo travel with directional changes and light footwork
small jumps and elevated foot taps on beats during solo segment
